description: Nested call vectors, Celo only: a token that calls sweep, cancel or execute back into the mandate during recover_token, a leg transfer or withdraw, either propagating or catching the refusal.

vectors.description: On Celo a token that calls sweep back during recover_token, a sweep that would otherwise move the rest of the balance, and lets the refusal propagate fails the outer call with TRANSFER_FAILED.
On Celo a token that calls sweep back during recover_token, a sweep that would otherwise move the rest of the balance, and catches the refusal lets the outer call succeed with no nested effect.
On Celo a token that calls cancel back during recover_token, a cancel of a lapsed payout that anyone could otherwise make, and lets the refusal propagate fails the outer call with TRANSFER_FAILED.
On Celo a token that calls cancel back during recover_token, a cancel of a lapsed payout that anyone could otherwise make, and catches the refusal lets the outer call succeed with no nested effect.
On Celo a token that calls execute back during recover_token, an execute the token could otherwise make as an executor, and lets the refusal propagate fails the outer call with TRANSFER_FAILED.
On Celo a token that calls execute back during recover_token, an execute the token could otherwise make as an executor, and catches the refusal lets the outer call succeed with no nested effect.

On Celo a token that calls sweep back during a leg transfer in execute, a sweep, which the active mandate would refuse anyway, and lets the refusal propagate fails the outer call with TRANSFER_FAILED.

On Celo a token that calls sweep back during a leg transfer in execute, a sweep, which the active mandate would refuse anyway, and catches the refusal lets the outer call succeed with no nested effect.

On Celo a token that calls sweep back during withdraw, a sweep that would otherwise move the rest of the balance, and lets the refusal propagate fails the outer call with TRANSFER_FAILED.
On Celo a token that calls sweep back during withdraw, a sweep that would otherwise move the rest of the balance, and catches the refusal lets the outer call succeed with no nested effect.
On Celo a token that calls cancel back during withdraw, a cancel of a lapsed payout that anyone could otherwise make, and lets the refusal propagate fails the outer call with TRANSFER_FAILED.
On Celo a token that calls cancel back during withdraw, a cancel of a lapsed payout that anyone could otherwise make, and catches the refusal lets the outer call succeed with no nested effect.
